job.title: Surveyors - Australia
job.description:
Vision Surveys is looking for experienced Construction Surveyors from New Zealand who are ready for their next adventure in Australia. With opportunities across Brisbane, Gold Coast, Rockhampton, Gladstone and Airlie Beach, you can choose a location that suits your lifestyle while working on great projects with a team of good humans.
  
Who We Are
Vision Surveys (QLD) has been operating in Queensland for over a decade, with our three Directors bringing more than 50 years of combined local experience.
We provide comprehensive Mining, Engineering and Cadastral Land Surveying and Town Planning services across Queensland. We’re big on culture, good people and creating a workplace where you actually enjoy turning up to work.
  
The Opportunity
We’re looking for Construction Surveyors currently based in New Zealand who are interested in relocating to Queensland and joining the Vision Surveys team.
Opportunities are available across: Brisbane, Gold Coast, Rockhampton, Gladstone and Airlie Beach. Roster options include Monday to Friday or 2 weeks on 1 week off roster. 
  
Whether you're chasing the city lifestyle, coastal living or somewhere a little more relaxed, we have opportunities across some awesome Queensland locations.
  
There are a range of large construction, civil, infrastructure and major projects, wind farm and main roads projects with plenty of variety and opportunities to grow.
  
What’s On Offer
  • Relocation allowance to help you make the move from New Zealand to Australia
  • Excellent pay rates
  • Great projects across Queensland
  • Vision Vehicle 
  • Phone allowance
  • Multiple Queensland locations to choose from
  • Supportive and down-to-earth team
  • Plenty of work and opportunities for development
  • The chance to make the move to sunny Queensland and enjoy a new lifestyle

Key Responsibilities
  • Conduct field surveys, site measurements and data collection
  • Prepare survey plans, reports and spatial data outputs
  • Operate surveying instruments including GPS, total stations and digital levels
  • Ensure accuracy and compliance with project specifications and safety requirements
  • Liaise with clients, engineers, site managers and internal teams
  • Manage project documentation and maintain accurate records
  • Report to and communicate with the Survey Manager

What We’re Looking For
  • Leica or Trimble surveying equipment
  • Experience with surveying software such as 12d, Magnet or AutoCAD is advantageous
  • Degree or Diploma in Surveying or a related discipline
  • Previous experience working as a Surveyor or in a similar surveying role
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Strong communication and organisational skills
  • Current open driver’s licence
Ready for a Sea Change? If you’ve been thinking about making the move from New Zealand to Australia, this could be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.
Come work on great projects, earn good rates and enjoy the Queensland lifestyle with opportunities across Brisbane, Gold Coast, Rockhampton, Gladstone and Airlie Beach.
  
Ready to make the move? APPLY NOW!

job.title: Assistant Site Manager - Cootamundra
job.description:
About RWM
Regional Workforce Management (RWM) is proudly Australian-owned, dedicated to connecting businesses with tailored recruitment and workforce management solutions since 2000. Formerly FIP Group, we’ve spent over two decades supporting the backbone of Australia - the food, agriculture, forestry and fisheries industries. By blending local expertise with a national reach, we deliver reliable and committed people who help businesses grow, thrive and stand strong.
 
What started as a small operation helping local businesses quickly grew into something much bigger. Our founders’ ability to connect with people - sharing experiences, solutions and hope – helped forge strong bonds with businesses and communities alike. As we expanded from labour hire to permanent recruitment and into connecting skilled workers from across the borders, our mission has remained the same: to provide real solutions that save Australia’s food and agriculture business time and resources.
 
About The Role
We are currently seeking an Assistant Site Manager to support day-to-day operations and personnel onsite in Cootamundra. This role will see you play a crucial role in fostering positive relationships and empowering staff.
 
This role is a permanent, full-time role (Monday-Friday).
 
In this position, your duties will also include:
  • Assist Site Manager with arrivals of new personnel to site and mobilisation e.g., inductions, site access, transport, accommodation.
  • Assist with the coordination and management of mobilisation of Pacific Australia Labour Mobility (PALM) scheme workers.
  • Transportation of employees to clinics and appointments.
  • Assist with conflict resolution and addressing employee issues proactively.
  • Manage accommodation and vehicle inspections and reports if required.
  • Support onsite employee wellbeing including regular check-ins and follow ups.
  • Assist with the education and mentoring of onsite employees in relation to workplace operations.
  • Fostering the relationship between the client and RWM onsite employees.
  • Conduct return to work procedures for site activities.
  • Escalate serious breaches or seek guidance on desired outcome to Internal HR.
  • Educate and coach onsite employees and visitors on safe site practices.
  • Monitor and report site safety and WHS policies and procedures.
  • Provide coverage or support to Site Managers in peak periods or to cover absences.
About You
To excel in this position, you should be committed to delivering results and supporting onsite personnel. Your dedication to this role and the fostering of positive relationships is crucial to your success in this role.
 
You should also possess the following attributes:
  • People management experience
  • Intermediate computer literacy, including Microsoft Suite skills
  • High level written and verbal communication skills
  • Exposure to the fundamentals of Human Resources, HR experience is desirable
  • Open Drivers Licence and reliable vehicle
  • Ability and willingness to receive a QFever vaccination and complete a Police Check
  • Experience working with a culturally diverse workforce is desired
If this sounds like an opportunity that excites you, we want to hear from you. APPLY NOW!
 
**Please note only successful candidates will be contacted**

job.title: Marketing Manager
job.description:
The Opportunity
We are seeking a talented Marketing Manager to join our team and help drive continued growth across a portfolio of brands within our Engineering, Trades & Labour (ETL) division. This is a fixed-term maternity leave cover opportunity, offering the chance to step into a well-established marketing role and make an impact across a diverse portfolio of brands.
Reporting to the Head of Marketing & Communications, this role combines strategy with hands-on delivery. With the support of a Marketing Coordinator, you’ll develop and execute marketing plans that drive revenue growth, client and candidate attraction, brand awareness and stronger commercial outcomes.
Working closely with divisional leaders, Sales and Operations, you’ll gain a strong understanding of each brand’s market, competitors and customers to identify growth opportunities and deliver measurable results.
  • Fixed-term maternity leave cover
  • Full-time position – Brisbane HQ
  • Growth and development opportunities
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Collaborative, fast-paced environment 
About the Role
In this role, you will:
  • Develop and execute marketing strategies aligned with ETL growth priorities
  • Drive client and candidate acquisition through digital, content, events and targeted campaigns
  • Partner with Sales and Operations on growth opportunities, ABM and sector campaigns
  • Lead brand positioning, messaging, website, capability and campaign development
  • Improve digital performance across SEO, AI/LLM visibility, paid media and social
  • Develop sales enablement content, including proposals, case studies, insights and collateral
  • Optimise client and candidate journeys through automation, retention and conversion strategies
  • Plan and deliver events, sponsorships and thought leadership activity
  • Track marketing performance, lead flow and pipeline outcomes
  • Support tenders, RFIs and priority divisional or Group initiatives 
What You’ll Bring
You’re a proactive and adaptable marketer who enjoys combining big-picture strategy with hands-on delivery. You’re comfortable managing competing priorities, collaborating with a variety of stakeholders and working across multiple brands.
Ideally, you will have:
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Media & Communications or a related field
  • 5+ years’ experience developing strategic marketing plans and campaigns
  • Strong digital campaign management and optimisation skills
  • Strong project management, multitasking and decision-making skills
  • A data-driven approach with demonstrable marketing results
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • A strong eye for creativity and content creation
  • Experience with CMS platforms and Mailchimp
  • CRM experience, such as Salesforce
  • Experience with Facebook Manager and LinkedIn Campaign Manager
  • Basic design skills using Canva 
Why Join Us?
You’ll have the opportunity to work across a diverse portfolio of brands while partnering closely with teams across the business. We encourage professional development and further study, with opportunities to grow your career within the wider Group.

job.title: Payroll Officer - Brisbane
job.description:
About RWM

Regional Workforce Management (RWM) is proudly Australian-owned, dedicated to connecting businesses with tailored recruitment and workforce management solutions since 2000. Formerly FIP Group, we’ve spent over two decades supporting the backbone of Australia - the food, agriculture, forestry and fisheries industries. By blending local expertise with a national reach, we deliver reliable and committed people who help businesses grow, thrive and stand strong.
  
What started as a small operation helping local businesses quickly grew into something much bigger. Our founders’ ability to connect with people, sharing experiences, solutions and hope. Helped forge strong bonds with businesses and communities alike. As we expanded from labour hire to permanent recruitment and into connecting skilled workers from across the borders, our mission has remained the same: to provide real solutions that save Australia’s food and agriculture business time and resources.

About the Role

We are seeking a Payroll Officer to join our Brisbane team; someone who enjoys working with numbers, genuinely cares about accuracy, and loves being part of a supportive workplace. In this role, you will take ownership of weekly and fortnightly payroll processing, ensuring a smooth and positive experience for our employees. Your day-to-day will include:
  • Processing weekly and fortnightly payroll
  • Collecting and reviewing timesheets and ensuring approvals are in place
  • Interpreting awards, the NES, and other employment conditions
  • Calculating termination payments, adjustments, and leave accruals
  • Responding to payroll queries and maintaining compliance
  • Managing payroll transactions across manual and automated systems
  • Processing invoices based on payroll data
About you

To be successful in this role you will be a strong communicator with the ability to build relationships across the business at all levels. You will be career focused with the drive to take on further opportunities and challenges as they rise. 
  
You will also have:
  • Preferably have 1+ years experience as a payroll officer
  • Ability to understand and interpret awards
  • An aptitude for working with bulk data
  • Accuracy and a keen eye for detail which your referees will attest to
  • Ability to work efficiently either in a team environment or individually 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • High competence with Microsoft Office 
If you believe you have what it takes to thrive in this role, we want to hear from you! Click ‘APPLY NOW’.
